signals_info.description: Whether the target-side blind spot is occupied; 0 means clear.

nl_Literal_translation_en: From 1 to 5 seconds from now, the target-side blind spot shall remain unoccupied.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 从现在起第 1 秒到第 5 秒之间，目标侧盲区应始终处于未被占用状态。
nl_Paraphrase_en: During the lane-change window from the first through the fifth second, the target-side blind spot shall remain clear.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 在第 1 秒至第 5 秒的变道窗口内，目标侧盲区应持续保持无占用。
